summary: Frontend-only regression of the 'Aviso importante' modal loop bug fix on the public Consulpam/Sobral site. Tested 5 required scenarios via Playwright against the external URL https://inscricao-concurso.preview.emergentagent.com/. All required scenarios pass: (1) modal shows on first load in a fresh session, (2) 'Ok, entendi' closes the modal (class 'show' removed, display=none, sessionStorage['__aviso_modal_dismissed']='1'), (3) 'Fazer Inscrição' navigates to /inscricao.html and the inscription form (CPF, Nome Completo, Email) renders without the modal reopening, (4) reloading the home in the same session does NOT reopen the modal (one-shot honored), (5) subsequent clicks on 'Fazer Inscrição' continue to navigate correctly. Scenario (6) — clicking 'Fazer Inscrição' while the modal backdrop is still open — the backdrop intercepted the click and the button did not navigate; this is explicitly flagged as acceptable in the request (backdrop blocks underlying elements). No JS console errors observed. The reported infinite-modal-loop bug is not reproducible with the current fix.
critical_code_review_comments: public/index.html: inline onclick uses window.location.href='/inscricao.html'; combined with href attribute this is redundant but harmless. Consider relying on the anchor's default navigation alone once the modal capture listener is proven stable.

The global capture-phase click listener uses getAttribute traversal which is fine, but for accessibility/keyboard users pressing Enter on 'Fazer Inscrição' while modal is open, the default anchor navigation may still fire before the modal closes visually. Not a functional bug.
sessionStorage one-shot is per-tab; opening the site in a new tab shows the modal again — intended behavior, but worth documenting.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 required scenarios; optional scenario 6 acceptable-fail as documented)

test_credentials: n/a - public static pages, no auth involved
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public site is static HTML at /app/frontend/public/index.html (source) and /app/frontend/build/index.html (served). Aviso-importante modal logic lives around lines 547-590 of the source; uses sessionStorage['__aviso_modal_dismissed'] one-shot and a document-level capture-phase click listener that closes the modal when a data-noavisomodal='1' element is clicked. 'Fazer Inscrição' anchor has data-testid='fazer-inscricao-btn', href='/inscricao.html', data-noavisomodal='1', and an inline onclick that stopPropagation + window.location.href. Tests must clear sessionStorage before validating first-load behavior.
rca of the issue: Original bug: clicking 'Fazer Inscrição' re-opened the 'Aviso importante' modal instead of navigating, causing a loop. Fix applied by main agent (verified in build): (a) explicit href='/inscricao.html' + inline onclick with stopPropagation and window.location.href on the anchor, (b) data-noavisomodal='1' marker, (c) modal script now records dismissal in sessionStorage and only calls show() when not dismissed, (d) capture-phase document click listener closes modal if a data-noavisomodal ancestor is clicked, and (e) stopPropagation/preventDefault in close(). Verified working end-to-end in a fresh browser session against the external preview URL.
